title: Roles
description: The work hats. Each one is a set of permissions, and people wear one.
unavailable: We couldn't read your roles just now.
allows: {count, plural, =0 {Allows nothing yet} =1 {Allows one thing} other {Allows # things}}

scope.none: No reach set - they see what their role allows by default

overrides.heading: Exceptions to their role
overrides.none: No exceptions. This person has exactly what their role allows.
overrides.added: given on top of their role
overrides.removed: taken away from what their role allows
overrides.notInCatalogue: this permission is not in the catalogue, so we cannot say what it allows

elsewhere: Passwords and signed-in sessions live in your identity provider, not in GOTCHA - we don't hold either. Deactivating someone here keeps their history and stops them signing in.

catalog.heading: What a role can allow
catalog.scopeIsPerRole: A role has one reach, and it applies to everything the role does - not to each permission separately. Choose it once for the role.
catalog.notLevels: Each line here is its own switch. There is no "view / edit / manage" ladder: reading a conversation and closing one are separate permissions, and someone can have either without the other.

remove.where: After this, nothing else in GOTCHA will show that it was taken away. It appears on this person's panel, and in the override count on Roles - nowhere else.
remove.reasonPlaceholder: Pending a review, on leave, requested by finance…
remove.reasonRequired: Required. The person this affects will ask someone why, and this is the only place that answer lives.

error.forbidden: You don't have permission to change this.
error.gone: That person or permission no longer exists.
error.needs_reason: Say why first - a removal without a reason leaves nobody able to explain it.
error.past_date: That date has already passed - pick one ahead.

form.heading: New role
form.startFromHint: Copies that role's permissions so you only change what differs. It does not link the two: later edits to {name} will not reach this one.
form.name: Name
form.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions selected} one {# permission selected} other {# permissions selected}}

error.name_taken: A role with that name already exists. Choose another name.
error.unknown_features: The server refused some of these permissions. That is a mismatch between this list and what it will grant, not something you did - nothing was created.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to create roles.
error.failed: The role could not be created. Nothing was changed.

form.noLevels: A permission is held or it is not. GOTCHA has no None / View / Edit / Manage levels - the design shows four and the catalogue stores one bit per permission.
form.noLimits: Money limits cannot be set on a permission. There is no amount stored anywhere, so a role that may issue refunds may issue any refund.
form.wildcardHeading: This role grants permissions by pattern
form.wildcardBody: It holds {patterns}. A pattern means “everything under this, including permissions added later” - so it is a standing instruction, not a list. Ticking the boxes it matches today would freeze it, and the role would stop keeping up the next time a permission is added.
form.wildcardCannotSeed: The checkbox list cannot express that, so this role cannot be used as a starting point. Choose one without patterns, or start from nothing.
form.scopeHint: How far this reaches - own, team, department or workspace - is set when the role is given to someone, not here.
form.elseSame: Everything else is the same as {name}.
form.giveNotYet: Giving this role to someone from here comes next.

person.title: One person
person.description: What this person can do, and every exception somebody made to their role.
person.notLive: Changing this from here comes next.
person.noField: GOTCHA has no field for this yet.
person.nothingToSave: Nothing here is saved from this drawer yet - adding and removing a permission save themselves.

editNotYet: Editing a role from here comes next.

cards.extraBody: Give one person a permission on top of their role, without changing the role.
cards.aiBody: What they may do is set in Studio · Integrations, the same for every employee.

foot: Built-in roles can't be changed or deleted. Duplicate one to make a role you can.

grant.title: Add a permission for {name}
grant.done: Added. It applies to {name} from now on.
